description: Discover the best hotels in Cairns, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Central City Retreat on Cairns Esplanade with Outdoor Swimming Pool & Onsite Restaurant
hotels.description: Perfectly placed on the Cairns Esplanade, Pacific Hotel Cairns puts the city's best within easy reach. Cruise the Great Barrier Reef from the Reef Fleet Terminal just steps away, or venture out to the ancient rainforests of Daintree National Park for the day. At the hotel, the Esplanade Lagoon is a short stroll away for a swim, or head up to the pool deck as the sun sets over the city skyline. End the evening at Bushfire Flame Grill with Brazilian-inspired rotisserie, or linger over a cocktail at the bar before heading upstairs.

hotels.title: Cairns Five-Star Shangri-La Escape at the Gateway to the Great Barrier Reef
hotels.description: Experience the magic of Tropical North Queensland with its dazzling white-sand beaches and turquoise waters from the world-class Shangri-La The Marina, Cairns, a five-star resort-style escape right on the water. Cairns Esplanade's stylish bars and world-class restaurants are at your fingertips, as is the Reef Fleet Terminal, your gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Great Barrier Reef. Ranked within the top 10% of properties on Tripadvisor, Shangri-La The Marina, Cairns has a lagoon-style pool, lush gardens and a health club with state-of-the-art equipment.

hotels.title: Beachfront Cairns Esplanade Escape with Lagoon Pool & Ocean Views
hotels.description: Explore seaside living in Cairns with a stay along the city's Esplanade. Lounge by the resort's lagoon-style pool or enjoy alfresco dining at the onsite BBQ area. With the Esplanade right on your doorstep and easy access to the area's main attractions, you're perfectly placed to make the most of your time with family or friends.

hotels.title: Cairns Esplanade Oasis with Lagoon-Style Pool & City's Highest Rooftop Bar
hotels.description: Experience the tropical allure of Cairns from the luxury of the five-star Riley by Crystalbrook Collection. Ideally located on the Esplanade, the hotel is just a short stroll from the vibrant dining and shopping precinct. Savour innovative flavours at Paper Crane or enjoy a cocktail at Rocco, Cairns' highest rooftop bar. Explore the nearby Great Barrier Reef and Daintree Rainforest, or simply relax by the spectacular lagoon pool.

hotels.title: Cairns Esplanade Escape Overlooking the Coral Sea
hotels.description: Craving a trip to the tropics? Look no further than Rydges Esplanade Resort Cairns, boasting a picture-perfect location on the iconic Cairns Esplanade and easy access to the Great Barrier Reef cruise terminals. This stylish property places everything you need at your fingertips, and when you're ready to return to your Cairns base, enjoy the use of the three tropical swimming pools and two tennis courts. Throughout your stay, be sure to catch the sunset over the Coral Sea from one of the many restaurants and bars near the water, or visit the region's must-see sights, including Kuranda Scenic Railway and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Daintree Rainforest
